_about: Real vinted.it pages (October 2026), trimmed and anonymised: ids of people and other items replaced, seller names, e-mails and image addresses replaced. Both parsers (server and extension) must read them like this. item_sold_plugins.html and item_sold_no_scripts.html are the same sold item: the first keeps the item's page data (its status banner section says 'Venduto', can_buy is false), the second has no scripts (only the 'Venduto' badge above the item's summary says it is sold). item_active_plugins.html keeps the item's real 'favourite' section. view_count: the current layout shows no view count. seller_member: the (fake) member id the opaque seller key is made from; seller_rating null when the seller has no reviews yet.
